description: This PHP class defines the LowOrderFee model for OpenCart, which adds an additional fee to the order total if the subtotal is below a configured threshold. It modifies the totals and taxes arrays based on the order total and configuration settings.

classes.name: LowOrderFee
classes.description: Model class responsible for adding a low order fee to the total if the cart subtotal is below a certain threshold.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adds the low order fee to the order totals if the subtotal is below a configured amount, updating totals, taxes, and total accordingly.
